metadata.title: Implement Zustand UI Store and Toast Notifications

story.iWant: feedback when I perform actions in the app
story.soThat: I know my changes were saved successfully

tasks.task:
Create Zustand UI Store
Install zustand if not already installed: npm install zustand Create src/store/uiStore.ts with UI state and actions Define currentPage state with type 'dashboard' | 'data-entry' | 'compare' | 'track' Define selectedStrategyId state as string | null Define isLoading state as boolean Implement setCurrentPage(page) action Implement setSelectedStrategy(id) action Implement setIsLoading(loading) action Create src/store/index.ts barrel export

Migrate Navigation to Zustand Store
Update src/App.tsx to remove local currentPage useState Import useUIStore in App.tsx to get currentPage Update Navigation component to use useUIStore for state Update MobileNav component to use useUIStore for state Verify navigation still functions correctly after migration

Implement Toast Notification System
Add shadcn/ui toast component: npx shadcn@latest add sonner Add Toaster component to src/App.tsx Configure toast positioning to bottom-right Configure success toasts: green color, 3-second auto-dismiss Configure error toasts: red color, require manual dismiss Create a demo button (temporary) to test toast functionality

Create Result Type Utility
Create src/lib/utils/result.ts with Result type definition Export Result<T, E = Error> type with success and failure variants Add helper functions: ok<T>(data: T) and err<E>(error: E) Create src/lib/utils/index.ts barrel export

Write Tests
Create tests/store/uiStore.test.ts Test initial state values Test setCurrentPage action Test setSelectedStrategy action Test setIsLoading action Create tests/lib/utils/result.test.ts Test Result type ok() helper Test Result type err() helper Update existing navigation tests if needed Verify all tests pass with npm run test

acceptanceCriteria.ac: Given the application is running When the UI store is initialized Then a Zustand store exists at src/store/uiStore.ts with state: currentPage ('dashboard'|'data-entry'|'compare'|'track'), selectedStrategyId (string|null), isLoading (boolean)
Given the UI store exists When I call setCurrentPage(page) action Then the currentPage state updates to the specified page
Given the UI store exists When I call setSelectedStrategy(id) action Then the selectedStrategyId state updates to the specified ID
Given the application loads When the Navigation component renders Then it reads currentPage from the Zustand store (instead of local App.tsx state)
Given I click a navigation tab When the click handler fires Then it calls setCurrentPage from the Zustand store to update the active page
Given the application is running When I view the app Then the shadcn/ui Toaster component is rendered in App.tsx
Given a success event occurs When I call toast.success('message') Then a green toast notification appears in the bottom-right corner
Given an error event occurs When I call toast.error('message') Then a red toast notification appears in the bottom-right corner
Given a success toast is displayed When 3 seconds pass Then the toast auto-dismisses
Given an error toast is displayed When I view the toast Then it requires manual dismissal (does not auto-dismiss)
Given the codebase requires error handling When I need to return success or failure Then a Result type utility exists at src/lib/utils/result.ts with type Result<T, E = Error>
Given the Result type exists When I use it in code Then I can pattern match on { success: true; data: T } or { success: false; error: E }

doc.title: Architecture Document
doc.snippet: Zustand stores live in src/store/ with uiStore.ts for UI state (selected strategy, modals) and calculationStore.ts for calculation state.

doc.title: Architecture Document
doc.snippet: Use Zustand for UI state, Dexie for persistent data. Zustand chosen over React Context for no provider nesting, selector-based re-renders (performance), clean separation.

doc.title: Architecture Document
doc.snippet: Result<T, E> type with success/failure variants. Calculation functions return Result, React components show toast on error.

doc.title: UX Design Specification
doc.snippet: Saves: Green toast notification, 3-second auto-dismiss. Errors: Red alert banner, manual dismiss.

doc.title: Product Requirements Document
doc.snippet: The system provides confirmation feedback for data modifications via toast notifications.

doc.title: Epics Document
doc.snippet: Implements Zustand UI store, toast notification system, and Result type utility for error handling.
